results.fix: Installed the shipped scripts’ declared R package dependencies into the task-local R library and ran each unmodified script from a working directory containing copies of the supplied .RData inputs. No model, sample, or data changes.
results.note: The supplied manuscript .R script reports 0.057. Its packaged rendered RMarkdown output reports 0.055. The .R script omits optimism_index from model m1, while the RMarkdown model includes it; the 0.002 absolute difference is therefore attributable to inconsistent shipped specifications.

findings.description: The all-participant MTurk treatment estimate in Table 1 does not recur from the manuscript .R script: 0.057 instead of 0.055. The shipped R and rendered RMarkdown files specify different models for this column.
findings.evidence: logs/manuscript.log prints 0.057. The supplied AJPS_2021_Kim_Manuscript_RMarkdown.html reports 0.055; the corresponding RMarkdown model includes optimism_index, omitted by m1 in AJPS_2021_Kim_Manuscript.R.
findings.suggested_fix: Align the shipped .R model with the published specification and rerun; this certification did not alter the analysis.

findings.description: The archive specifies R 4.1.0 on macOS Catalina; this run used R 4.6.1 on macOS Tahoe. Ten required packages were installed into a task-local library; all declared script packages and versions are recorded in the environment block.
findings.evidence: AJPS_Kim_readme.txt states R 4.1.0 / macOS Catalina 10.15.7; sessionInfo.txt records R 4.6.1 / macOS Tahoe 26.7.
findings.suggested_fix: For exact historical environment matching, rerun with R 4.1.0 and the contemporaneous package versions.

limitations: The claim list covers selected headline numerical outputs and key appendix outputs; graphical results were executed but not compared point-by-point.

The paper and archive contain multiple code representations; results from the README-designated .R scripts are the reproduction basis. Rendered RMarkdown outputs were used only as the source of the printed comparison values.
Original code and data were not copied into the certification bundle or uploaded.
